sections.title: Inputs And Dependency Graph
sections.text: parts required nonempty array of unique names. dependencies optional array of [prerequisite, dependent] pairs: the prerequisite is assembled before the dependent. removedParts optional names to disassemble. disconnectedMedia optional {name, connects:[a,b], rigid?:false} media links that require disconnection but are never rigid joints. serviceStates optional {part, requires:[{state}|{media,state}|{part,action}]} real disconnection/service states. phases optional {name, parts:[...]} groups; each part in at most one phase. schemaVersion required 1. Flexible media never create a rigid ordering edge.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'assembly.sequence',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,order:[parts],disassemblyOrder:[parts reversed],blockers:{part:[prerequisites]},removals:[{part,removeBlockers,disconnections,servicePrerequisites}],cycles:[...],mediaRigidized:false,mediaDisconnections:[...],phaseAssignments:{...},unphased:[...]}. status is fail when a rigid dependency cycle exists (cycles lists the involved parts) and pass otherwise. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Connector Pull Before Shaft Close
examples.requires: Open Design document; a connector installed before the shaft, with a PWR-cable linking them.
examples.output: result.order is [base, connector, shaft, housing]; result.removals for connector lists disconnection of PWR-cable and result.mediaRigidized is false.

examples.label: Trapped Screw Detected By Dependency
examples.requires: Open Design document; a screw installed before the cover, so the cover traps it.
examples.output: result.order places screw before cover; result.removals[0].removeBlockers includes cover (the cover must come off first).

examples.label: Head Ring Power Service States
examples.requires: Open Design document; three serviceable parts with real disconnection states.
examples.output: result.removals entries carry their servicePrerequisites: power requires powerOff and power-cable disconnected.

sections.title: Inputs And Withdrawal Sweep
sections.text: part required {name?, outline:[[x,y],...]} cross-section polygon in the withdrawal plane. direction required two finite unitless numbers [dx,dy]. distance required positive withdrawal length. obstacles optional {name?, outline, span?:[start,end]} polygons; span limits where along the withdrawal an obstacle is present. minimumClearance optional default 0 mm. samples optional positive integer default 20. schemaVersion required 1. The sweep samples the part outline translated along the withdrawal direction; an exploded endpoint is never treated as a feasible path.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'service.path-check',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,feasible,blocked,minClearance,clearanceAtStations:[...],blockers:[names],samples,withdrawalDistance,sweptBounds:{min,max}}. status is pass when feasible (no blocker), fail when blocked. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Tank Withdrawal
examples.requires: Open Design document; a tank withdrawn upward 30 mm past a side wall 5 mm away from the swept strip.
examples.output: result.feasible is true and result.blockers is empty; result.minClearance is about 0.5 cm.

examples.label: Trapped Part Blocked Along The Sweep
examples.requires: Open Design document; a plug withdrawn upward into a cage that overlaps its swept strip.
examples.output: result.blocked is true, result.blockers contains cage and result.status is fail.

verified: endpoint is not treated as a feasible path

sections.title: Inputs And Tool Sweep
sections.text: tool required {diameter, length} cylindrical envelope. target required {origin, axis, engagementDepth?}: the tool tip must reach origin + axis*engagementDepth. entry required {origin, direction}: the access point and approach direction (must align with the target axis). obstacles optional {name?, point:[x,y,z], radius?} spheres or {name?, box:{min,max}} boxes. minimumClearance optional default 0 mm. samples optional positive integer default 20. schemaVersion required 1. The cylinder is a simplification, not a full fingers/grip model.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'tool.access',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,reachable,reach,toolDiameter,toolLength,lengthSufficient,axisAligned,engagementDepth,clearances:[{obstacle,minClearance,blocks}],minClearance,blockers}. status is pass when reachable (aligned, length sufficient and no blocker), fail otherwise. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: D6x40 Tool Reaches A Fastener
examples.requires: Open Design document; a 6 mm-diameter 40 mm-long tool reaching 26 mm to a fastener past a rib 6 mm off-axis.
examples.output: result.reachable is true, result.lengthSufficient is true and result.blockers is empty.

examples.label: Trapped Screw Blocked By A Boss
examples.requires: Open Design document; a boss 1 mm off-axis overlapping the 3 mm tool radius along the approach.
examples.output: result.reachable is false, result.blockers contains boss and result.status is fail.

verified: cylindrical envelope swept along the approach

sections.title: Inputs And Seating
sections.text: part required {name?, features:[{name,kind,origin,direction?,diameter?}]} with kind pin, hole or datum. fixture required {name?, approach:{direction}, features:[...]}. pairs required nonempty array of [partFeature, fixtureFeature]. tolerance optional default 0.01 mm (datum coincidence). angleTolerance optional default 1 deg. clearance optional default 0 mm (radial clearance for a pin-in-hole fit). schemaVersion required 1. A part seats when every pair fits and the part can reach the fixture along the approach direction.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'fixture.access',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,seatPossible,approach,tolerance,angleTolerance,clearance,pairs:[{part,fixture,kinds,lateralOffset,axialGap,angle,fits,reasons}],blockers:[...]}. status is pass when seatPossible (all pairs fit), fail otherwise. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: PCB Seats With Pin And Datum
examples.requires: Open Design document; a 2 mm pin into a 2.1 mm hole and a coincident datum.
examples.output: result.seatPossible is true and every pair.fits is true.

examples.label: Misaligned Datum Blocks Seating
examples.requires: Open Design document; a datum offset 2 mm laterally with a 0.5 mm tolerance.
examples.output: result.seatPossible is false, result.pairs[0].fits is false and result.blockers has one entry.
